[[File:Crinum Moorei Flowers Ooty Jul26 OM3 0691.jpg|thumb|''Crinum moorei'' flowers, [[Ooty]], India]]
'''''Crinum moorei''''' is a [[herbaceous]] plant belonging to the family [[Amaryllidaceae]], and native to [[South Africa]] (the [[Cape Provinces]] and [[KwaZulu-Natal]]).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023 |title=Amaryllidaceae> Crinum> ''Crinum moorei'' |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:63990-1 |access-date=9 August 2026 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]]}}</ref>

== Distribution ==
''Crinum moorei'' is native to Cape Provinces and KwaZulu-Natal in South Africa.  It has been introduced in Peru, Ecuador, Mexico and Korea.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023 |title=Amaryllidaceae> Crinum> ''Crinum moorei'': Distribution |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:63990-1#distributions |access-date=9 August 2026 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]]}}</ref>  It is grown in the [[Nilgiri Mountains|Nilgiris]] and [[Idukki district|Idukki]] in the [[Western Ghats]] of South India.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Sankara Rao |first1=K. |last2=Swamy |first2=R.K. |last3=Kumar |first3=D. |last4=Arun Singh |first4=R. |last5=Gopalakrishna Bhat |first5=K. |date=2019 |title=Flora of Peninsular India: ''Crinum moorei'' |url=https://indiaflora-ces.iisc.ac.in/FloraPeninsular/herbsheet.php?id=562&cat=7 |access-date=9 August 2026 |website=[[Indian Institute of Science]]}}</ref>
